images.filename: Wat Phra Kaew by Ninara TSP edit crop.jpg
images.caption: Wat Phra Kaew, viewed from the Outer Court of the Grand Palace, just inside the Wisetchaisi Gate. Also known as the Temple of the Emerald Buddha, it is Thailand's primary Buddhist temple. Located within the grounds of the Grand Palace, Wat Phra Kaew is technically a royal chapel, as unlike regular temples it does not include living quarters for Buddhist monks.Edit by me, User:TSP, of File:Wat_Phra_Kaew_by_Ninara_(33271955941).jpg as permitted by the CC-BY licence of that file.
images.alt: Wat Phra Kaew, viewed from the Outer Court of the Grand Palace, just inside the Wisetchaisi Gate. Also known as the Temple of the Emerald Buddha, it is Thailand's primary Buddhist temple. Located within the grounds of the Grand Palace, Wat Phra Kaew is technically a royal chapel, as unlike regular temples it does not include living quarters for Buddhist monks.Edit by me, User:TSP, of File:Wat_Phra_Kaew_by_Ninara_(33271955941).jpg as permitted by the CC-BY licence of that file.
